description: Versive lets you run AI-moderated user research from ChatGPT. Create studies that combine fixed survey questions (multiple choice, ratings, NPS, ranking) with adaptive AI-interview questions, organize them with question groups and branching logic, and share a link that participants take as a conversational interview. As responses come in, check completion and drop-off stats, per-question aggregates, and individual interview transcripts, or export everything as CSV — without leaving the chat.

defaultPrompt: Create a customer discovery study about our onboarding flow with multiple choice, NPS, and AI interview questions
How is my research study performing? Where are people dropping off?
Pull quotes from my study interviews and summarize the main themes
